'''Old Recluse's cave''' was a cave on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Morishim]] known to be inhabited by the [[Old Recluse]]. The cave was in fact a secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] communications center.

==Description==
The Old Recluse's cave was located in the [[High Tatmana]]. It contained a fully functioning Imperial communications center: encrypt/decrypt modules, input jacks for a variety of droids and sensor feeds, a space/planetary monitor module, and a self-contained [[Generations III]] [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]].

==History==
The communications center was set up before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces evacuated the planet in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]]. The cave was inhabited by the [[Old Recluse]], an ancient [[Morish]] and Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. He used the cave's equipment to act as a kind of prophet in order to impress and indoctrinate the Morishm population. He also spied the neighboring [[Morishim New Republic starfighter base|New Republic Starfighter Base]].

The trick was discovered by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] when he went to the cave with [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] to listen the story about the [[Caamas Firestorm]]. He smelled and recognirzed the odor of the old electronic equipments.
